mapper.sql: s.SUBJECT_ID, s.SUBJECT_CODE, s.SUBJECT_NAME, s.SUBJECT_TYPE, s.BALANCE_DIRECTION, s.IS_ENABLED, s.CREATE_TIME, s.UPDATE_TIME
mapper.select:
SELECT s.SUBJECT_ID as subjectId, s.SUBJECT_CODE as subjectCode, s.SUBJECT_NAME as subjectName, s.SUBJECT_TYPE as subjectType, s.BALANCE_DIRECTION as balanceDirection, NVL(sb.BEGINNING_BALANCE, 0) as openingBalance, NVL(SUM(CASE WHEN v.VOUCHER_STATUS = 2 OR #{param.includeUnposted} = 1 THEN ve.DEBIT_AMOUNT ELSE 0 END), 0) as debitAmount, NVL(SUM(CASE WHEN v.VOUCHER_STATUS = 2 OR #{param.includeUnposted} = 1 THEN ve.CREDIT_AMOUNT ELSE 0 END), 0) as creditAmount, (NVL(sb.BEGINNING_BALANCE, 0) + NVL(SUM(CASE WHEN v.VOUCHER_STATUS = 2 OR #{param.includeUnposted} = 1 THEN ve.DEBIT_AMOUNT ELSE 0 END), 0) - NVL(SUM(CASE WHEN v.VOUCHER_STATUS = 2 OR #{param.includeUnposted} = 1 THEN ve.CREDIT_AMOUNT ELSE 0 END), 0)) as closingBalance,
CASE WHEN s.BALANCE_DIRECTION = 1 AND (NVL(sb.BEGINNING_BALANCE, 0) + NVL(SUM(CASE WHEN v.VOUCHER_STATUS = 2 OR #{param.includeUnposted} = 1 THEN ve.DEBIT_AMOUNT ELSE 0 END), 0) - NVL(SUM(CASE WHEN v.VOUCHER_STATUS = 2 OR #{param.includeUnposted} = 1 THEN ve.CREDIT_AMOUNT ELSE 0 END), 0)) >= 0 THEN 1 WHEN s.BALANCE_DIRECTION = 2 AND (NVL(sb.BEGINNING_BALANCE, 0) + NVL(SUM(CASE WHEN v.VOUCHER_STATUS = 2 OR #{param.includeUnposted} = 1 THEN ve.DEBIT_AMOUNT ELSE 0 END), 0) - NVL(SUM(CASE WHEN v.VOUCHER_STATUS = 2 OR #{param.includeUnposted} = 1 THEN ve.CREDIT_AMOUNT ELSE 0 END), 0)) <= 0 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END as isNormal
FROM T_ACCOUNT_SUBJECT s LEFT JOIN T_VOUCHER_ENTRY ve ON s.SUBJECT_ID = ve.SUBJECT_ID AND ve.IS_DELETED = 0 LEFT JOIN T_ACCOUNTING_VOUCHER v ON ve.VOUCHER_ID = v.VOUCHER_ID AND v.ACCOUNTING_PERIOD = #{param.accountingPeriod} AND v.IS_DELETED = 0 AND (#{param.includeUnposted} = 1 OR v.VOUCHER_STATUS = 2) LEFT JOIN TBL_SUBJECT_BALANCE sb ON s.SUBJECT_CODE = sb.SUBJECT_CODE AND sb.ACCOUNTING_PERIOD = #{param.accountingPeriod} AND sb.BOOK_ID = CAST(#{param.bookId} AS VARCHAR(64)) AND sb.TENANT_ID = CAST(#{param.tenantId} AS VARCHAR(64)) WHERE s.BOOK_ID = #{param.bookId} AND s.TENANT_ID = #{param.tenantId} AND s.IS_ENABLED = 1 AND s.IS_DELETED = 0
AND s.SUBJECT_TYPE = #{param.subjectType}
AND s.SUBJECT_ID IN
#{subjectId}
AND s.SUBJECT_ID NOT IN
#{subjectId}
GROUP BY s.SUBJECT_ID, s.SUBJECT_CODE, s.SUBJECT_NAME, s.SUBJECT_TYPE, s.BALANCE_DIRECTION, sb.BEGINNING_BALANCE
HAVING ABS(NVL(sb.BEGINNING_BALANCE, 0) + NVL(SUM(CASE WHEN v.VOUCHER_STATUS = 2 OR #{param.includeUnposted} = 1 THEN ve.DEBIT_AMOUNT ELSE 0 END), 0) - NVL(SUM(CASE WHEN v.VOUCHER_STATUS = 2 OR #{param.includeUnposted} = 1 THEN ve.CREDIT_AMOUNT ELSE 0 END), 0)) > 0.01
ORDER BY s.SUBJECT_CODE

SELECT s.SUBJECT_ID as subjectId, s.SUBJECT_CODE as subjectCode, s.SUBJECT_NAME as subjectName, s.SUBJECT_TYPE as subjectType, s.BALANCE_DIRECTION as balanceDirection, NVL(sb.BEGINNING_BALANCE, 0) as openingBalance, NVL(SUM(ve.DEBIT_AMOUNT), 0) as debitAmount, NVL(SUM(ve.CREDIT_AMOUNT), 0) as creditAmount, (NVL(sb.BEGINNING_BALANCE, 0) + NVL(SUM(ve.DEBIT_AMOUNT), 0) - NVL(SUM(ve.CREDIT_AMOUNT), 0)) as closingBalance FROM T_ACCOUNT_SUBJECT s LEFT JOIN T_VOUCHER_ENTRY ve ON s.SUBJECT_ID = ve.SUBJECT_ID AND ve.IS_DELETED = 0 LEFT JOIN T_ACCOUNTING_VOUCHER v ON ve.VOUCHER_ID = v.VOUCHER_ID AND v.ACCOUNTING_PERIOD = #{accountingPeriod} AND v.IS_DELETED = 0 LEFT JOIN TBL_SUBJECT_BALANCE sb ON s.SUBJECT_CODE = sb.SUBJECT_CODE AND sb.ACCOUNTING_PERIOD = #{accountingPeriod} AND sb.BOOK_ID = CAST(#{bookId} AS VARCHAR(64)) WHERE s.SUBJECT_ID = #{subjectId} AND s.BOOK_ID = #{bookId} AND s.IS_ENABLED = 1 AND s.IS_DELETED = 0 GROUP BY s.SUBJECT_ID, s.SUBJECT_CODE, s.SUBJECT_NAME, s.SUBJECT_TYPE, s.BALANCE_DIRECTION, sb.BEGINNING_BALANCE

SELECT ve.SUBJECT_ID as subjectId, SUM(ve.DEBIT_AMOUNT) as totalDebit, SUM(ve.CREDIT_AMOUNT) as totalCredit FROM T_VOUCHER_ENTRY ve INNER JOIN T_ACCOUNTING_VOUCHER v ON ve.VOUCHER_ID = v.VOUCHER_ID AND v.ACCOUNTING_PERIOD = #{accountingPeriod} AND v.BOOK_ID = #{bookId} AND v.IS_DELETED = 0 WHERE ve.IS_DELETED = 0 GROUP BY ve.SUBJECT_ID ORDER BY ve.SUBJECT_ID

SELECT s.SUBJECT_ID as subjectId, s.SUBJECT_CODE as subjectCode, s.SUBJECT_NAME as subjectName, s.SUBJECT_TYPE as subjectType, s.BALANCE_DIRECTION as balanceDirection, NVL(sb.OPENING_BALANCE, 0) as openingBalance, 0 as debitAmount, 0 as creditAmount, NVL(sb.OPENING_BALANCE, 0) as closingBalance FROM T_ACCOUNT_SUBJECT s LEFT JOIN TBL_SUBJECT_BALANCE sb ON s.SUBJECT_ID = sb.SUBJECT_ID AND sb.ACCOUNTING_PERIOD = #{accountingPeriod} AND sb.BOOK_ID = #{bookId} AND sb.TENANT_ID = #{param.tenantId} AND sb.IS_DELETED = 0 WHERE s.BOOK_ID = #{bookId} AND s.TENANT_ID = #{param.tenantId} AND s.IS_ENABLED = 1 AND s.IS_DELETED = 0
AND s.SUBJECT_ID IN
#{subjectId}
ORDER BY s.SUBJECT_CODE

SELECT s.SUBJECT_ID as subjectId, s.SUBJECT_CODE as subjectCode, s.SUBJECT_NAME as subjectName, s.SUBJECT_TYPE as subjectType, s.BALANCE_DIRECTION as balanceDirection, 0 as openingBalance, NVL(SUM(ve.DEBIT_AMOUNT), 0) as debitAmount, NVL(SUM(ve.CREDIT_AMOUNT), 0) as creditAmount, (NVL(SUM(ve.DEBIT_AMOUNT), 0) - NVL(SUM(ve.CREDIT_AMOUNT), 0)) as closingBalance FROM T_ACCOUNT_SUBJECT s LEFT JOIN T_VOUCHER_ENTRY ve ON s.SUBJECT_ID = ve.SUBJECT_ID AND ve.ACCOUNTING_PERIOD = #{accountingPeriod} AND ve.BOOK_ID = #{bookId} AND ve.TENANT_ID = #{param.tenantId} AND (#{includeUnposted} = 1 OR ve.VOUCHER_STATUS = 'POSTED') AND ve.IS_DELETED = 0 WHERE s.BOOK_ID = #{bookId} AND s.TENANT_ID = #{param.tenantId} AND s.IS_ENABLED = 1 AND s.IS_DELETED = 0
AND s.SUBJECT_ID IN
#{subjectId}
GROUP BY s.SUBJECT_ID, s.SUBJECT_CODE, s.SUBJECT_NAME, s.SUBJECT_TYPE, s.BALANCE_DIRECTION HAVING NVL(SUM(ve.DEBIT_AMOUNT), 0) > 0 OR NVL(SUM(ve.CREDIT_AMOUNT), 0) > 0 ORDER BY s.SUBJECT_CODE

SELECT s.SUBJECT_ID as subjectId, s.SUBJECT_CODE as subjectCode, s.SUBJECT_NAME as subjectName, 'DIRECTION_ERROR' as errorType, 'WARN' as errorLevel, '科目余额方向可能异常' as description, '请检查科目余额计算是否正确' as suggestion, 0 as errorAmount FROM T_ACCOUNT_SUBJECT s WHERE s.BOOK_ID = #{bookId} AND s.TENANT_ID = #{tenantId} AND s.IS_ENABLED = 1 AND s.IS_DELETED = 0 AND s.SUBJECT_TYPE IN (1, 5) -- 资产和费用类 AND EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM T_VOUCHER_ENTRY ve WHERE ve.SUBJECT_ID = s.SUBJECT_ID AND ve.ACCOUNTING_PERIOD = #{accountingPeriod} AND ve.BOOK_ID = #{bookId} AND ve.TENANT_ID = #{tenantId} AND ve.IS_DELETED = 0 )

SELECT s.SUBJECT_ID as subjectId, s.SUBJECT_CODE as subjectCode, s.SUBJECT_NAME as subjectName, s.SUBJECT_TYPE as subjectType, s.BALANCE_DIRECTION as balanceDirection, 0 as openingBalance, NVL(SUM(ve.DEBIT_AMOUNT), 0) as debitAmount, NVL(SUM(ve.CREDIT_AMOUNT), 0) as creditAmount, (NVL(SUM(ve.DEBIT_AMOUNT), 0) - NVL(SUM(ve.CREDIT_AMOUNT), 0)) as closingBalance FROM T_ACCOUNT_SUBJECT s LEFT JOIN T_VOUCHER_ENTRY ve ON s.SUBJECT_ID = ve.SUBJECT_ID AND ve.ACCOUNTING_PERIOD <= #{endPeriod} AND ve.BOOK_ID = #{bookId} AND ve.TENANT_ID = #{param.tenantId} AND ve.IS_DELETED = 0 WHERE s.BOOK_ID = #{bookId} AND s.TENANT_ID = #{param.tenantId} AND s.IS_ENABLED = 1 AND s.IS_DELETED = 0
AND s.SUBJECT_ID IN
#{subjectId}
GROUP BY s.SUBJECT_ID, s.SUBJECT_CODE, s.SUBJECT_NAME, s.SUBJECT_TYPE, s.BALANCE_DIRECTION ORDER BY s.SUBJECT_CODE
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO TBL_TRIAL_BALANCE_HISTORY ( TASK_ID, ACCOUNTING_PERIOD, BOOK_ID, TENANT_ID, TOTAL_DEBIT, TOTAL_CREDIT, DIFFERENCE, IS_BALANCED, CREATE_TIME, CREATOR ) VALUES ( #{result.taskId}, #{result.accountingPeriod}, #{result.bookId}, #{result.tenantId}, #{result.totalDebit}, #{result.totalCredit}, #{result.difference}, #{result.isBalanced}, SYSDATE, 1 )
mapper.select: SELECT DISTINCT ACCOUNTING_PERIOD FROM T_VOUCHER_ENTRY WHERE BOOK_ID = #{bookId} AND TENANT_ID = #{tenantId} AND IS_DELETED = 0 AND ACCOUNTING_PERIOD IS NOT NULL ORDER BY ACCOUNTING_PERIOD DESC
